applications.title: BlueDot Career Transition Grants
primary_source_facts: Career Transition Grants support a defined period of full-time personal transition into AI safety or biosecurity.
Applications are open to everyone; prior BlueDot participation is not required.
The application asks for recent evidence, work samples, milestones, theory of change, and a simple budget.
The grant is not intended to run alongside a full- or part-time role.
If circumstances change and a full-time role is secured, remaining funds are expected to be returned.
supported_by: PER-HUMANAIOS-ACAT-001: recent AI-safety/governance work and accessible public work samples
PER-HUMANAIOS-BOT-001: recent technical experimentation and external deployment
PER-STJOES-HPLC-001 and regulated-quality PERs: analogous evidence for disciplined execution, validation, and adaptation under uncertainty
unresolved_or_boundary: The $2,400 health-insurance/tax-reserve/required-cost figure still needs a time basis: monthly versus total/annual.
If a full-time role is accepted while the grant is active, replay this branch because the program requires full-time transition focus.
Program fit does not establish funding approval.
